### Plan to Update Minimum TLS Version for Apps to 1.2

1. **Update App1**:  
   - RecordAction: Title: "Set Minimum TLS Version to 1.2 for App1", Status: Pending.  
   - Execute `SetMinimumTlsVersion` tool to update App1 to TLS 1.2.  
   - RecordAction: Title: "Set Minimum TLS Version to 1.2 for App1", Status: Completed.  
   - Poll every 10 seconds using `GetSuccessfulRequestVolume` to check traffic before and after the change for anomalies.

**Rollback Process for Anomalies**:  
   - If an anomaly is detected for any app:  
     - Notify user.  
     - RecordAction for rollback: Title: "Rollback TLS Version for <AppName>", Status: Pending.  
     - Rollback using `SetMinimumTlsVersion` to restore the previous TLS version.  
     - RecordAction for rollback: Title: "Rollback TLS Version for <AppName>", Status: Completed.  
   - Resume with the next app unless multiple rollbacks happen, in which case terminate the remainder of the plan.  

**Completion Summary**:
